services.title: Commercial & Industrial Installations

services.title: PAT Testing & Compliance

about_pullquote: I started Liver Elec because customers were being overcharged by cowboys. That hasn't changed.
about_para_1: Liver Elec & Facilities Services Ltd has been serving Liverpool and the surrounding areas since 2006. Founded on the principle that honest pricing and rapid response should be standard, not rare, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, doing the job right, and explaining what we're doing every step of the way. Our team is NICEIC registered and regularly trained on the latest electrical codes and safety standards.
about_para_2: We specialise in both emergency call-outs and planned electrical work, from new kitchen circuits to full house rewires. Domestic customers trust us because we answer the phone, come when we say we will, and don't charge premium rates for common sense. Commercial clients value our reliability and our ability to minimise downtime. Repeat business makes up over 70% of our work — the best compliment we could ask for.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last year and they did a brilliant job. The lads were tidy, got it done in the timescale promised, and explained everything as they went. Saved us a fortune compared to other quotes. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm on a Sunday with a power issue. They arrived at 12:15, found the problem (dodgy circuit breaker), and fixed it for a fair price. No drama, no surcharge for the time. That's the sort of electrician you want.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: We use Liver Elec for all our electrical maintenance at the office. Always professional, they keep us in the loop on what needs doing, and they're competitive. Much better than the big national firms.
reviews.author: David P.
